prompt:
Use case: style-transfer edit. Make ONE full-body Persona 5 Joker game-character illustration.
Input 1 key_mask_hold is the EDIT BASE for the POSE ONLY. Repaint its 3D rendering into the polished 2D ink and cel-shading style of input 2 idle_a3. Input 2 controls appearance, exact head dimensions relative to body, shoulder width, torso length, slim limb proportions, detailed costume and rendering style. Input 3 face_standard controls facial identity, eye drawing, natural irises with highlights, and gently rounded chin.
Strictly preserve input 1's pose and viewing direction: standing upright, legs nearly straight, feet fairly close together in exactly the shown relative placement, body three-quarter front toward screen RIGHT. His RIGHT red-gloved hand is held against his face, fingers spread across the face in the same arrangement as input 1, palm near cheek and nose, right forearm raised diagonally in front of the chest, elbow bent and held forward. The LEFT arm hangs naturally down at his side, empty hand relaxed. Head is angled screen RIGHT as in input 1; visible eye looks forward along the face direction. Preserve the base pose's torso lean, shoulder angle, arm position and coat silhouette rather than copying idle's hanging right arm or wide stance. No crouch, no squatting, no wide-legged stance.
Render only the character and clothing: the hand touches his bare face. NO MASK on face or in hand, no flames, no aura or effects, no props. Preserve the black high-collared long coat, gray gold-chained waistcoat, red gloves, black trousers and brown boots of idle_a3 with crisp expressive official P5-style 2D linework and hard cel shading, not rough 3D textures. Full illustrated head from hair top to chin should be the same pixel height as idle_a3, about 200 pixels; no oversized head. Same overall character scale and torso length as idle_a3. Reframe the square input 1 into full-body 1024x1536 portrait: character fills height like idle_a3, hair near y20 and soles near y1500, all coat and feet fully inside canvas. Genuinely transparent RGBA background with no ground shadow, halo, glow, background, text, blood or visual effects. Exactly two arms and hands, only the right hand at the face.
Precision for this redraw: the head is NOT to be enlarged. Keep hair-top-to-chin distance equal to idle_a3, around 200 pixels. Match the standard facial proportions. Preserve a visible small natural rounded CHIN and lower jaw below the red glove; fingers rest across the upper cheek/bridge/forehead, while the palm is at the cheek side, not covering the entire lower jaw and neck. Keep the facial silhouette and rounded lower chin readable in the same pose. This is still the original hand-at-face pose, with identical elbow position, upright body and close feet. Do not invent a crouch or wide stance.
